pub type Raw
pub mod secure_store
  pub const WINDOWS_CREDENTIAL_MANAGER: &str
  pub const SECRET_SERVICE: &str
  pub const FILE_0600: &str
  pub const MACOS_KEYCHAIN: &str
  pub const NONE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 5]
pub mod state
  pub const ACTIVE: &str
  pub const EXPIRED: &str
  pub const REVOKED: &str
  pub const LOST: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 4]
pub enum StoreOutcome
  Stored
  Conflict
  Invalid
  UnsupportedKind
  NoSecureStore
  Exhausted
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 8]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum RotateOutcome
  Rotated
  Unknown
  Conflict
  Invalid
  NoSecureStore
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum RevokeOutcome
  Revoked
  Unknown
  Conflict
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum PageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ApplyOutcome
  Applied
  Unknown
  Expired
  Revoked
  Lost
  NotPermitted
  TargetRefused
  ConsumerRefused
  UnsupportedKind
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 12]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 6]
pub const CREDENTIAL_KINDS: [&str; 2]
pub const RESOURCE_ACTIONS: [&str; 3]
pub const EXECUTION_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub const CONSUMERS: [&str; 3]
pub struct Subject
  account: String
  program: String
pub struct Scope
  targets: Vec<String>
  consumers: Vec<String>
pub struct Metadata
  name: String
  kind: String
  revision: String
  state: String
  scope: Scope
  registered_by: Subject
  registered: String
  expires: String
  header: String
  last_applied: String
pub struct Registration
  name: String
  kind: String
  scope: Scope
  expires: String
  header: String
  secret: Vec<u8>
pub struct Rotation
  name: String
  expires: String
  secret: Vec<u8>
pub struct StoreResult
  outcome: StoreOutcome
  revision: String
  current: Option<Metadata>
pub struct RotateResult
  outcome: RotateOutcome
  revision: String
  current: Option<Metadata>
pub struct RevokeResult
  outcome: RevokeOutcome
  revision: String
pub struct Limits
  max_credentials: i64
  max_secret_bytes: i64
  tombstone_retention_ms: i64
  audit_retention_ms: i64
  audit_capacity: i64
  secure_store: String
  supported_kinds: Vec<String>
pub struct MetadataPage
  outcome: PageOutcome
  limits: Limits
  records: Vec<Metadata>
  next: String
  complete: bool
pub struct AuditEntry
  sequence: i64
  time: String
  event: String
  name: String
  revision: String
  subject: Option<Subject>
  consumer: String
  target: String
  outcome: String
pub struct AuditPage
  outcome: PageOutcome
  entries: Vec<AuditEntry>
  next: String
  at_end: bool
pub struct Use
  subject: Subject
  consumer: String
  name: String
  target: String
  challenge: String
pub struct CheckResult
  outcome: ApplyOutcome
  revision: String
pub struct ApplyResult
  outcome: ApplyOutcome
  revision: String
  headers: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub fn encode(v: &Registration) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Registration, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Holder
  type Error
  fn store(&self, expected_revision: String, registration: Registration) -> Result<StoreResult, Self::Error>
  fn rotate(&self, expected_revision: String, rotation: Rotation) -> Result<RotateResult, Self::Error>
  fn revoke(&self, expected_revision: String, name: String) -> Result<RevokeResult, Self::Error>
  fn list(&self, cursor: String, limit: i64) -> Result<MetadataPage, Self::Error>
  fn audit(&self, cursor: String, max_entries: i64) -> Result<AuditPage, Self::Error>
pub struct HolderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Applier
  type Error
  fn check(&self, usage: Use) -> Result<CheckResult, Self::Error>
  fn apply(&self, usage: Use) -> Result<ApplyResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ApplierClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub mod internal
  pub fn micros_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
  pub fn wide_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
